 MVPP Admit Card 2026-27 Out: Download Link, Exam Date and Instructions
 MVPP Admit Card 2026-27 Out: Download Link, Exam Date and Instructions
 Mayank Mishra Updated on 17 Nov 2026, 12:50 PM IST 
 The Directorate of Education, Delhi, has released the MVPP admit card 2026-27 on November 16, 2026, for students appearing in Mukhyamantri Vigyan Pratibha Pariksha. They can get their Pratibha Pariksha admit card from their respective schools. School authorities can download the MVPP admit card from the official website at edudel.nic.in and distribute it to students. The last date to download the admit card is November 20, 2026. The examination will be conducted on November 21, 2026 from 12 noon to 3:20 pm.

 Steps to Download MVPP Admit Card 2026-27
 The Directorate of Education, Delhi, has released the MVPP admit card on the official website at edudel.nic.in. However, students cannot directly download the admit card from the official website. The head of the school can download it from the official website, take two copies of the admit card and hand them over to the student. Schools can download the MVPP admit card 2026-27 by following the steps mentioned below:
 Visit the official website at edudel.nic.in.
 Go to the ‘School Plant’ section.
 Click on the ‘Scholarship’ option.
 Choose ‘School Information Entry Form’ and click on the ‘Application Form’ option.
 Log in using the required credentials.
 Search for the registered students’ admit cards.
 Download and take two printouts of the MVPP admit card 2026-27 and hand over both copies to the students.

 The Directorate of Education, Delhi has issued some important instructions to the heads of government, government-aided, and unaided recognised private schools, including Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, NDMC schools, Delhi Cantonment Board schools and other recognised institutions within the GNCT of Delhi for downloading and issuing the admit cards to the students. Take a look at the important instructions for the head of the school for downloading and issuing the admit cards:
 Schools can download the admit cards from the same portal where students did their registration.
 After downloading the admit card, schools must take two printouts of each admit card and hand over both copies to the student. One copy will be submitted to the invigilator in the examination centre, and the second copy will be kept by the student for their future reference.
 A recent passport-size photograph must be attached to both copies of the admit card.
 The attached photograph must be attested by the head of the school.
 Students must sign in the specified space given on the admit card.
 The head of the school needs to sign and provide an official stamp in the designated space on the admit card.
 School authorities are instructed to check the student’s name, father's name, category, photograph and examination centre details printed on the admit card.
 The school authorities must inform the students regarding the examination centre, reporting time and other details mentioned in the admit card.
 Students must be told to carry both attested copies of the admit card, their school identity card and a blue or black ballpoint pen. They should also be told that mobile phones, calculators, smart or digital watches, bags, books and papers are not allowed inside the examination hall.
